description:
World::function_source (src/compiler2/world.rs:1424-1430) returns
Option<FunctionSource> built with `Some(*source.clone())`: a deep copy of
the function's source form on every call.

Evidence (develop @ cca160808):
- jobs/source.rs:285 and :356 call it only for .is_none() / .is_some().
- Other callers: source_publish.rs:440, :631; jobs/keying.rs:306;
  jobs/source.rs:303, :369; drive_harness.rs:1145.
- World::expanded_function_source (world.rs:1432-1434) has the same owned
  shape via `.get(function).cloned()`; callers jobs/source.rs:282, :300.

Change: both return Option<&FunctionSource>. Presence checks read the
borrow; a caller that needs ownership clones at its own call site, where
the cost is visible.

Method: change the signature, run cargo check, sort the failing callers
per the epic strategy. Record in this ticket how many callers were pure
appeasement and how many interleave a World read with a World write -- that
ratio sizes .4 and .5.

Neighbour: fz-afu.7 deletes expanded_function_source outright. If it lands
first, this ticket covers function_source only.

Removal ledger: the `*source.clone()` in function_source; the `.cloned()`
in expanded_function_source; every caller-side clone made redundant.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement.
title: World hands out function source by reference
